component.name: LiDAR-Knight Auth
component.summary: Open-source two-factor authenticator, a fork of Ente Auth

description.p: LiDAR-Knight Auth is a modified fork of Ente Auth by Ente Technologies, Inc., with a red dot-matrix look. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ente.
It shows TOTP, HOTP and Steam codes, works offline with no account, and keeps your codes encrypted on this device. Optional end-to-end encrypted sync uses Ente's own service.
It also has tags, icons, pins, import, and export (encrypted or plain text).
